hits.name: Gossip Goblin
hits.hook: Two-word title, no caption, a 2:56 video: 'The Art Chippa' pulled 67,488 views, 1,509 likes and 336 bookmarks - Gossip_Goblin's title-only video format keeps working.
hits.video_tip: Post a 2-3 minute character short with a two- or three-word title and nothing else; open on the weirdest frame of the character so the thumbnail does the hook.
hits.draft_en: Gossip_Goblin's Art Chippa is the reminder I needed today: a strong character plus a two-word title beats any long thread. No caption tricks, just the video doing the work.

outsiders.name: Higgsfield AI 🧩
outsiders.text:
Introducing MAGI-2, exclusively on Higgsfield.

Up to 30 seconds of frontier 1080p quality, with 0.08$ per second of generation.

Open weights video model with 400B parameters coming soon.

Now available exclusively on Higgsfield and via Higgsfield API. https://t.co/CPgNTOf7og
outsiders.original_en:
Introducing MAGI-2, exclusively on Higgsfield.

Up to 30 seconds of frontier 1080p quality, with 0.08$ per second of generation.

Open weights video model with 400B parameters coming soon.

Now available exclusively on Higgsfield and via Higgsfield API. https://t.co/CPgNTOf7og
outsiders.hook: Higgsfield's MAGI-2 launch: 1,927,065 views, 1,974 likes, 933 bookmarks. A hard price (0.08$ per second), a hard spec (30s, 1080p) and an open-weights 400B promise in four short lines.
outsiders.video_tip: Lead with the price tag on screen ('$2.40 for 30s') over your best 30-second single-take shot, then cut to a timer counting the full 30 seconds without a stitch.
outsiders.draft_en:
Thirty seconds of 1080p from a single generation, billed at 0.08$ a second. That is the pitch for MAGI-2, the new model Higgsfield just launched as an exclusive - in the app and through the Higgsfield API.

The bigger news for anyone making sci-fi shorts: a 400B parameters version is promised as open weights soon. Long single takes are exactly what a Warhammer battle scene needs.

outsiders.hook: Midjourney's Niji V8 launch: 749,336 views, 3,964 likes, 1,916 bookmarks. Anime model release with a feature list (precision prompting, consistent characters, coherence, editing model).
outsiders.video_tip: Test Niji V8 on one recurring character across 6-8 poses and expressions, then animate the best frame in your video model; show the grid first, motion second.
outsiders.draft_en:
Midjourney just switched on Niji V8, its newest anime model.

What caught my eye: characters that hold together from image to image, prompts it follows with precision, coherence they rank as best in class, plus a separate editing model on top. If you build recurring characters for anime or sci-fi shorts, that consistency piece is the one to test first.

outsiders.name: Kling AI
outsiders.text:
Style isn’t just what you make — it’s what you push to its fullest.

In the first Creator Highlights series for Kling Image 4.0, creators take their signature palette, composition, and texture to the max, turning a distinct visual language into something unmistakably their own.

Creators: Gizem Akdag @gizakdag 
Xiaohongshu: 梦珑AI · 一只壳 · 时见鹿 AIGC · PUPU · 万能妍仔的AIGC
outsiders.original_en:
Style isn’t just what you make — it’s what you push to its fullest.

In the first Creator Highlights series for Kling Image 4.0, creators take their signature palette, composition, and texture to the max, turning a distinct visual language into something unmistakably their own.

Creators: Gizem Akdag @gizakdag 
Xiaohongshu: 梦珑AI · 一只壳 · 时见鹿 AIGC · PUPU · 万能妍仔的AIGC
outsiders.hook: Kling's Creator Highlights for Kling Image 4.0: 247,259 views but only 352 likes (94.6K on the 23.11 board) - brand reach that looks promoted; 7-image carousel of creator styles.
outsiders.video_tip: Make a 7-frame style carousel of your own signature look (e.g. grimdark 40K palette) and caption it with what makes the style yours.
outsiders.draft_en:
Owning a look is not enough - the point is to push it as far as it will go.

That is the idea behind Kling Image 4.0 and its first-ever Creator Highlights run from Kling: each creator drives their palette, composition and texture to the extreme until the visual language could only be theirs.

Featured: Gizem Akdag @gizakdag, plus 梦珑AI, 一只壳, 时见鹿 AIGC, PUPU and 万能妍仔的AIGC from Xiaohongshu.

narrative_synthesis: Launch day dominated the outsider lane. Higgsfield's MAGI-2 announcement (30 seconds of 1080p for $0.08 a second, 400B open weights 'coming soon') hit 1.93M views and 933 bookmarks, and within hours a wave of creator posts repeated the same specs and the same closing line, "Biggest day in AI video" (mhdfaran 26.5K, chetaslua 22.1K, karankendre 19.6K, lyraxana 10.7K, plus The_Alex's 'Let's GOOOOO' at 21.4K) - it reads like a coordinated launch push, so treat that reach as campaign reach. The posts that earned saves were the ones that showed proof rather than specs: maxxmalist's top/bottom MAGI-2 vs Seedance 2.5 clip with prices burned in ($0.37 vs $2.4, 42.7K, 358 bookmarks), Higgsfield's Blender-previs camera-control tests (62.9K and 22.4K), and pounddz's MAGI-2 + Claude animation with a reply-to-get-the-workflow gate (17.7K, 327 bookmarks, 143 replies). A price war started the next morning (YouArt at $0.04/sec, 15.2K). The second big release was Midjourney's Niji V8 anime model (749K views, 1,916 bookmarks) with consistent characters and an editing model. Kling's Creator Highlights carousel climbed to 247K on just 352 likes (promoted-looking). Organic AI films still travel on a title alone: 'FORTY-TWO | An AI Sci-Fi Short Film' (62.4K from a 656-follower account, low engagement, treat with caution) and the ComfyUI + MiniMax H3 horror short 'DO YOU HAVE A BOYFRIEND?' (60.5K, 953 bookmarks from 1.4K followers). Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Hydrogen lightning-to-music globe (79.7K) and a slopcore celebrity dance video (14.3K) round it out. On the watchlist only Gossip_Goblin cleared the bar: the title-only 'The Art Chippa' at 67.5K plus a BTS podcast quote-post at 9.9K.

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
